name: Swanport Bridge
facts: Opened on 30 May 1979, Swanport Bridge was inaugurated by Transport Minister Geoff Virgo, marking a pivotal moment in South Australia's road network expansion.
Spanning one kilometre of prestressed concrete, the bridge features two single-lane traffic lanes without a median, a design choice that reflects its era's engineering priorities.
Since 2015, a reduced speed limit of 80 kilometres per hour has applied to the bridge, contrasting sharply with the 110‑km/h limits on the adjoining freeway and highway.
